name: vibe-sec
description: Vibe Sec — canary channel. Tracks the main branch of the solo repo. For stable releases pinned to tagged versions, install via the aggregated 626Labs marketplace at github.com/estevanhernandez-stack-ed/vibe-plugins.

plugins.name: vibe-sec
plugins.description: Security gap finder for vibe-coded apps — the tier-aware audit and orchestration layer that defers to gitleaks/OSV-Scanner/Semgrep when present and falls back to an in-house baseline when absent. Early access (v0.4.0): /vibe-sec:audit is live — a tier-calibrated scan across all ten concerns (secrets, deps, supply-chain, config, crypto/PII, auth-model, OWASP survey, rate-limiting) into a four-band report, plus :scan, :deps, :gate (CI-safe), :posture, and :fix (confidence-routed with destructive-action overrides). Threat-model synthesis and :research land next.
